in_sanskrit.name: जयशिंग
in_sanskrit.meaning: जय: victory, triumph, success + शिंग: lion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Jaysingh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'जय' (jaya) which means 'victory, triumph, success' and 'शिंग' (singh) which means 'lion'. The name represents the power and strength of a victorious lion.
